event.event_name: 2022 Uljin wildfire near Hanul nuclear plant corridor

primary_gt.interpretation: The local package supports a dry, wind-assisted wildfire mechanism through the report text, a positive heterogeneous dNBR signal, and a 170.0 km2 reported burned-area anchor. Gridded precipitation remains context rather than a late-rain control, and the ledger should not infer nuclear-plant damage or radiation release.

provenance.notes: Point-weather products are intentionally not used; calculations rely on report text, package gridded summaries, dNBR, and annual embedding context.

criteria.description: Returns answer, tests, and interpretation with all requested numeric and pass/fail fields.
criteria.name: Requested JSON ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a mostly complete ledger with one missing metric family.

criteria.description: Correctly identifies strong winds plus dry weather, smoke transport toward southern Japan, and absence of nuclear-damage evidence.
criteria.name: Report mechanism extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award roughly one point per correct report flag, with an extra point for avoiding overclaim.

criteria.description: Computes ERA5 mean wind speed and bearing, and the spread across ERA5, GPM, and CHIRPS precipitation means.
criteria.name: Gridded context calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit across wind speed, bearing, and precipitation spread.

criteria.description: Correctly reports dNBR mean, dNBR max-to-mean ratio, dNBR-to-annual-change ratio, and converts nearly 17,000 hectares to 170.0 km2.
criteria.name: Burn and area calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct burn or area anchor.

criteria.description: Marks dry/wind mechanism, smoke transport, and heterogeneous burn as pass, late-rain control as fail, and nuclear-damage overclaim as pass/avoided.
criteria.name: Threshold states and rejected alternatives
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct majority of test states.

criteria.description: Gives a ledger-bound interpretation and avoids plant damage, radiation, or exposure-to-loss statements.
criteria.name: Concise interpretation and limits
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct but wordy interpretation or one minor extra inference.
